capabilities: Open .epub files directly in the vault in a centered paginated reading view
Turn pages with the mouse wheel and navigate via a compact table of contents
Adapt the reader background to the theme or set a custom background color
Preserve publisher EPUB styles for headings, emphasis, and relative typography
Retain reading progress per book and anchor visible text when font size changes
extras: Warns that both this plugin and the original ePub Reader register the .epub extension, so the original must be disabled before enabling this one; retains the upstream MIT license and copyright notice. Install is pending community-plugin review; manual install via GitHub Release files is documented.
intentEvidence: This plugin replaces the unmaintained ePub Reader plugin.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to open and read EPUB ebook files stored in a vault.

relations.evidence: This plugin replaces the unmaintained ePub Reader plugin.
independently maintained and is based on caronchen/obsidian-epub-plugin, originally created by caronchen

summary: EPUB reader that opens .epub files in a paginated, theme-aware view with a table of contents, mouse-wheel paging, and per-book reading progress.
